items.reason: A low-strength 2.5% wash that helps keep the chin and jaw area looking clearer without being harsh on young skin.
A gentle, fragrance-free-style cleanser for mornings so skin isn't over-washed with an active twice a day.
A light, mattifying gel moisturizer that suits oily-looking skin and adds comfort after cleansing.
A mineral SPF 50 for daily protection, which also helps marks from spots look less noticeable.

response.routine_note: Use the gentle cleanser, moisturizer and SPF in the morning, and the benzoyl peroxide wash in the evening followed by moisturizer, starting every other night and rinsing off well. If spots feel painful, look deep or leave marks, a dermatologist or doctor is the better person to ask than anything we sell.
